title.en: An Act Amending Act Numbered Eleven Hundred and Forty-Seven By Providing for the Free Registration and Branding of Large Cattle Under Two Years of Age Under Certain Conditions.

text.en:
Section twenty-two of Act Numbered Eleven hundred and forty-seven is hereby amended to read
"Section 22. No transfer of large cattle of any age shall be valid unless such large cattle shall have first been
branded and originally registered in the manner prescribed in sections six and eight hereof: Provided,, That
large cattle under two years of age may be registered and branded gratis for the purpose of effecting a valid
transfer, if the registration and transfer are made at the same time."
Enacted, February 26, 1914.
